entities.summary: The Saparmyrat Hajji is a mosque in Gökdepe, Turkmenistan. Commissioned in memory of the defenders of Gökdepe Fortress, it was built between 1994 and 1995, during the presidency of President Saparmyrat Nyýazow. The mosque—with its blue dome and four minarets—is a prominent landmark in Gökdepe. Saparmurat Hajji Mosque is a mosque in Asia, established in 1994. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
